crosscheck.note: Both captures hold 174 games for 2026-10-20..2026-11-12. After normalising the team-code vocabulary used by each capture (CHO/CHA, BRK/BKN, PHO/PHX), the two sets have an identical key set and identical scores on all 174 games. The second capture is a cross-check only: its declared source is Basketball-Reference, which is not an official NBA property, so it is not used as a primary source (flag E-F-02).

gates.name: Data provenance
gates.checks: Every input row cites an official NBA property or the repository's own git history.
gates.evidence: 174 games cross-checked against an independent capture; 0 score mismatches. One prior capture cites a non-official source and is excluded from primary use.

gates.name: Leakage
gates.checks: Each feature used for a prediction is available strictly before that game's tip-off.
gates.threshold: Zero features stamped at or after tip-off
gates.evidence: By construction: every prediction at index i is fitted on games 0..i-1 only (walk-forward). The feature set is dates and scores.

gates.name: Beats a naive baseline
gates.checks: Out-of-sample error is better than the constant baseline, with a paired interval excluding zero.
gates.threshold: Paired t-test p < 0.05 and negative mean error difference
gates.evidence: selected model: margin RMSE 15.48 vs baseline 16.73 (paired t p=0.0170); total RMSE 18.90 vs baseline 19.30 (p=0.2913). Both markets must improve; a model that only forecasts the spread does not clear this gate.

gates.name: Minimum sample
gates.checks: Enough graded bets before any verdict on a strategy.
gates.threshold: At least 100 graded bets per strategy
gates.evidence: Largest strategy sample is 35 bets against a floor of 100. Eligible: none.

gates.name: Beats the break-even hurdle
gates.checks: Hit rate above break-even with the lower bound of the interval still above break-even.
gates.evidence: No strategy has a Wilson 95% lower bound above break-even 0.5213. Eligible: none.

gates.name: Luck removed
gates.checks: Observed performance is not reachable by chance at the same sample size.
gates.evidence: Strategies clearing permutation p<0.05: none. Two pass the raw test but fail the sample gate, which is the point of running both.

gates.name: Multiple-comparison control
gates.checks: A strategy that survives only because 12 were tried is rejected.
gates.evidence: Benjamini-Hochberg over 8 tested strategies at FDR 10%. Survivors: none.

gates.name: Temporal stability
gates.checks: Performance holds in both halves of the out-of-sample window.
gates.evidence: No strategy reaches the 100-bet sample floor, so split-half stability has nothing to judge. Half-window hit rates are published on the leaderboard for information only.

gates.name: Forward paper tracking
gates.checks: 200 picks tracked live before any model output is used for a decision.
gates.evidence: No forward paper tracking exists. This gate cannot be cleared by backtesting at all, and it is the only gate that measures the live process.

margin_total_residual.label: Residual of our spread forecast vs residual of our total forecast, same game
margin_total_residual.interpretation: CI includes 0 - no measurable dependence. A parlay that pairs a spread leg and a total leg from the same game is therefore treated as near-independent by this data, which is the opposite of the usual assumption.

same_game_parlay_joint.label: P(over our total AND home covers our spread) vs the product of the two marginals
same_game_parlay_joint.interpretation: A ratio above 1 means the same-game parlay pays out more often than independent legs imply; below 1, less often.

same_slate_cross_game.label: Do games on the same date share a forecast error?
same_slate_cross_game.note: Not estimated: with 114 out-of-sample games the within-date pairs are few and a meaningful interval is not reachable. Left blank rather than assumed to be 0 (flag E-F-06). This is the quantity a multi-game parlay depends on most.

spread_moneyline.label: Our spread vs our moneyline, same game
spread_moneyline.interpretation: Exactly 1 by construction: both are derived from one predicted margin. Correlation here is mechanical, not empirical, and must not be quoted as a measured value.

rest_edge_margin.label: Rest-day advantage (home minus away) vs actual home margin
rest_edge_margin.interpretation: Direction and size as measured on this sample only.

player_points_minutes.label: Player points vs player minutes, same player-game
player_points_minutes.note: BLOCKED. Only the 31 highest-minute players in the league were captured and there are no player game logs in the repository, so no player-level correlation can be estimated (flag E-F-07).
